title: Surreal Mirror Portal
description: A central woman with large green fairy wings and a pixelated mirrored dress stands in a dark surreal landscape, raising one hand toward a beam of light. Behind her, an ornate mirror reveals a modern interior where an identical woman in a red suit stands, surrounded by floating jellyfish, demonic eyes, melting staircases, Christmas ornaments, and gothic ruins under a blood-red sky.
prompt: A beautiful woman with large translucent green fairy wings wears a form-fitting dress covered in mirrored pixel tiles and floral patterns, standing dramatically in a dark surreal dreamscape. She raises one hand as light beams down from above. An ornate mirror behind her shows another version of herself in a red pantsuit inside a modern room. Floating jellyfish, black holes, demonic eyeballs, melting golden staircases, a poisoned apple, Christmas baubles, pink demons, and gothic ruins fill the chaotic scene under a vivid red sky.
